decisions.reason: As a certified HVAC line close to the core heat-exchanger business, it likely has low carrying cost and still retains option value because no clear negative market signal has appeared yet.
The reported major market share and strong quality reputation indicate that uncertainty has resolved positively, so management would almost certainly continue backing it.
This marine cooling unit fits established capabilities and markets, and after only a short time on the market management would usually keep it while demand potential is still being learned.
The compact oil cooler is an adjacent product line that can leverage existing engineering and sales channels, making it worth retaining absent evidence of weak performance.
Finned tubes for air coolers are somewhat more component-like and may face stronger competition, but the product is still close enough to the firm's installed base to justify keeping the option open.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's technical know-how and can support multiple exchanger applications, so management would likely continue offering them while market acceptance develops.
